name: Prescribing of inhalers (excluding salbutamol) with higher Global Warming Potential (GWP) propellant
description: Inhalers with higher Global Warming Potential (GWP) propellant prescribed as a proportion of all inhalers in BNF Chapter 3, excluding salbutamol
y_label: Percentage of non-salbutamol inhalers with higher Global Warming Potential (GWP) propellant prescribed
why_it_matters: The updated BTS/NICE/SIGN guidance on asthma management recommends basing inhaler choice on:
• the preference of the person receiving the treatment
• the lowest environmental impact among suitable devices
• the presence of an integral dose counter.
The NHS has committed to reducing its carbon footprint by 80% by 2028 to 2032,
including a shift to lower carbon inhalers. Dry powder inhalers (DPIs) and other newer types of inhalers like soft
mist inhalers are less harmful to the environment than traditional metered dose inhalers (MDIs).

Newer propellants, such as HFO-1234ze and HFA-152a, are considered to have lower Global Warming Potential (GWP) than the more traditional propellents, such as HFA-134a and HFA-227ea. HFO-1234ze containing devices are considered to be
similar to a DPI on a per-dose basis, and HFA-152a has shown to have
a 90% reduction in GWP compared with HFA-134a containing devices. We will add further devices when their Summary of Product Characteristics
list one of these propellants as an excipient.
produced a inhaler decision aid to facilitiate discussion about inhaler options.

change_log.description: Updated to include inhalers with newer propeallants.

design_notes: This measure uses vw__dmd_objs_with_form_route, which collates BNF codes at VMP, VMPP, AMP and AMPP level into a single view, along with a formulation route (e.g. oral.tablet).  This allows us to easily filter for numerator ('pressurizedinhalation.inhalation')

Note: We have to manually curate MDIs with the newer propellants, as the dm+d currently doesn't not contain excipients, and we haven't yet found a workable alternative solution.  This may be a suitable consideration during a review.
Also note: there may be multiple form_route for each presentation, hence the use of DISTINCT bnf_code, to ensure we don't get multiple counts, leading to incorrect values.
